wire.error: Could not reach the kernel. Start the kernel on 127.0.0.1:8765 and reload.
wire.error.unreachable: The kernel is not answering on 127.0.0.1:8765. Start it from this app, then try again.
wire.error.origin_not_allowed: The running kernel does not allow this app's origin, so the browser blocked its answer. Start the kernel with CORS_ORIGINS naming the shell's origin.
wire.error.no_credential: No kernel credential is configured, and the kernel requires one. Save the token in Settings.
wire.error.unauthorized: The running kernel rejected this app's credential. Save the current token in Settings.
palette.title: Command palette
settings.title: Settings
settings.origin.label: Kernel origin
settings.origin.invalid: Refused: only loopback origins (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) are allowed.
settings.locale.label: Language
settings.token.heading: Kernel authentication
settings.token.label: Kernel token
settings.token.hint: Keychain, then environment; never the browser.
settings.token.status.anonymous: No token configured; the loopback kernel is unauthenticated.
settings.token.saved: Token saved to the login keychain.
settings.token.rotated: Token saved; the running kernel uses it now.
settings.token.pending: Token saved; the kernel will use it when it starts.
settings.token.stale: Token saved to the login keychain, but the running kernel was not updated. Quit and relaunch the app to apply it.
settings.token.empty: Enter a token, or use Clear to remove the saved one.
settings.token.error: Could not update the login keychain. Try again.
recall.title: Recall
recall.subtitle: Deterministic recall with calibrated abstention.
recall.empty: Nothing recalled. Rephrase or store more first.
recall.error: The recall failed. Is the kernel running?
recall.abstain: Low confidence — recall stopped rather than guess. Nothing was invented.
recall.trace.title: Recall trace
recall.trace.subtitle: The stored decision path for trace {id}. The query is a hash — never raw text.
recall.trace.not_found: No trace is stored for this id.
recall.trace.error: The trace could not be read. Is the kernel running?
decisions.list.title: Decision Explorer
decisions.list.subtitle: Newest-first decision-run summaries. The kernel supports only limit and run_id.
decisions.list.limit.label: Rows
decisions.list.run_id.label: Workflow run ID (optional)
decisions.list.empty: No decision runs were returned for this page.
decisions.list.unauthorized: Authentication is required to list decision runs.
decisions.list.forbidden: This principal cannot list decision runs.
decisions.list.not_found: The requested decision-run page was not found.
decisions.list.conflict: The decision-run listing conflicts with the current kernel state.
decisions.list.bad_request: Choose a limit from 1 to 50 and a valid run ID.
decisions.list.malformed: The kernel returned a decision-run page that could not be verified.
decisions.list.network: The decision-run page could not be reached.
decisions.list.server: The kernel could not complete the decision-run listing.
decisions.detail.title: Decision trace {id}
decisions.detail.subtitle: Digest/reference evidence; raw query and evidence text are not stored.
decisions.detail.invalid: This trace id is not a valid non-negative integer.
decisions.detail.bad_request: The replay request could not be understood.
decisions.detail.not_found: No decision trace is stored for this id.
decisions.detail.unauthorized: Authentication is required to read this decision trace.
decisions.detail.forbidden: This principal cannot read this decision trace.
decisions.detail.conflict: The decision trace conflicts with the current kernel state.
decisions.detail.network: The decision trace could not be reached.
decisions.detail.malformed: The decision trace failed runtime verification.
decisions.detail.server: The kernel could not complete the decision trace read.
decisions.detail.unknown: The decision trace read was refused.
decisions.detail.no_stages: No completed stage records are stored.
decisions.detail.raw_omitted: Raw response exceeded the 1 MiB capture ceiling; download omitted.
decisions.replay.title: Replay diff
decisions.replay.notice: The original execution bundle is not stored. Supply config, rules, and input transiently to request a data-only replay.
decisions.replay.required: Supply every required field. Nothing is prefilled or reconstructed.
decisions.replay.invalid: Config and rules must be JSON objects; question fields must be valid.
decisions.replay.409: Config hash mismatch: the supplied config does not match the stored trace.
decisions.replay.400: The replay request was refused as invalid.
decisions.replay.403: This principal cannot replay this trace.
decisions.replay.404: The trace or workflow run is no longer available.
decisions.replay.network: The replay request could not be reached.
decisions.replay.malformed: The replay report failed runtime verification.
decisions.replay.server: The kernel could not complete replay.
decisions.replay.cleared: Transient bundle cleared; re-enter inputs for another replay.
chat.title: Conversation
chat.composer.label: Ask your memory
chat.absent.body: No memory matched. The search ran and the store holds nothing for it.
chat.abstained.title: I could not find that.
chat.abstained.next: Try widening the search, or ask a person.
chat.refused.body: Access refused (HTTP {status}). You do not have access to this memory. This is not an empty result.
chat.unreachable.body: Recall unavailable. Retrieval is degraded, not empty. ({detail})
chat.violation.body: The recall response could not be read. This is a contract fault, not an empty result. ({detail})
chat.correct.claim.label: Claim to check against this source
chat.correct.refused: not permitted to read this source
chat.correct.no_such_chunk: this source could not be served
chat.correct.unreachable: the kernel could not be reached
chat.correct.violation: the answer could not be read
chat.forget.human_gate: You decide. This is never approved automatically.
chat.forget.tombstoned: forgotten — hidden from recall, and still restorable
chat.forget.no_such_row: not available to you — nothing was erased
chat.forget.unavailable: could not be completed — erasure is degraded, not empty
chat.forget.violation: the answer could not be read — nothing is reported as forgotten
gate.consent.heading: Start the local kernel?
gate.consent.body: StewardMem keeps its kernel's data on this Mac, in the folder below. Nothing is sent to a remote server.
gate.consent.localOnly: Local only: the kernel listens on 127.0.0.1 and is reachable from this Mac alone.
gate.consent.modes: The data folder is owner-only (0700). The database, the bearer token and the log are owner-only files (0600).
gate.consent.cancelled: The kernel was not started and no data folder was created. You can retry when you are ready.
gate.refused.heading: The local kernel could not be used
gate.refused.mismatch: The running kernel is not the version this app was built with.
gate.refused.foreign: Port 127.0.0.1:8765 is held by another program that does not answer as a Brain kernel. It was not stopped.
gate.refused.inconsistent: The kernel's answer disagrees with itself: the response header and the body name different versions.
gate.refused.missingSidecar: The bundled kernel is missing. Reinstall the app.
gate.refused.missingProvenance: The bundled kernel's provenance record is missing or unreadable. Reinstall the app.
gate.refused.tokenUnavailable: The login keychain could not be used, so the local kernel was not started unauthenticated.
gate.refused.consentRefused: Storage was not granted, so the local kernel was not started.
gate.refused.insecureAuthFile: The kernel's token file is readable by other users. Fix its permissions (chmod 600) and retry.
gate.refused.startTimeout: The local kernel did not answer within the time limit. It was stopped.
gate.refused.spawnFailed: The local kernel could not be started.
gate.refused.statusFailed: The local kernel's state could not be read.
gate.refused.startFailed: The local kernel could not be started.
settings.update.heading: Software update
settings.update.unreachable: The update endpoint could not be reached.
review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: What is waiting for a human. Approve here rides the kernel’s own gate — role-checked, digest-bound, audited.
review.disclaimer: Display for everyone; approve for the authorized. The decision binds to the digest shown and is audited; reject and edit stay behind the kernel’s roles.
review.empty: The kernel reports no proposals waiting for review.
review.malformed: The kernel returned a review queue this app could not verify.
review.refused.title: The review queue was refused.
review.refused.unauthorized: This app's credential was refused (HTTP 401). Save the current token in Settings.
review.refused.forbidden: This app's credential may not read the review queue (HTTP 403). Reading the shared queue takes the reviewer's role.
review.offline.title: The kernel could not be reached — this is the last known state of the queue.
review.offline.nocache: This session has no cached copy of the queue.
review.offline.metadata_only: Only the metadata is cached — the proposal text is never written to this session's storage.
review.row.title: Proposal {id}
review.row.content_unavailable: Not available offline — the cached copy holds metadata only.
memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: What the kernel holds. Search it here — a chat turn is the same recall.
memory.search.label: Search memory
memory.filter.label: Show
memory.filter.empty: None of these results are of that kind.
memory.add.title: Add memory
memory.add.description: What you file here becomes a proposal. It waits in Review until you approve it — nothing enters the store on its own.
memory.add.filed: Filed as proposal #{id}. It is waiting in Review.
memory.add.offline: The kernel could not be reached. Nothing was filed.
memory.add.malformed: The kernel answered in a shape this app cannot read. Check Review before filing again.
audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Every read and write the kernel made, hash-chained. Rows carry hashes, never content.
audit.chain.refused: verifying the chain needs an Admin credential
audit.refused.title: The kernel refused the audit log
audit.refused.unauthorized: No credential was accepted (HTTP 401). Save the kernel token in Settings.
audit.refused.forbidden: This credential cannot read the audit log — it needs Admin (HTTP 403).
audit.malformed: The kernel answered in a shape this app cannot read.
audit.offline: The kernel could not be reached.
audit.since.label: Since
governance.title: Governance
governance.subtitle: What the kernel enforces: domains, roles and retention.
governance.refused.admin: This section needs an Admin credential (HTTP 403).
governance.offline: The kernel could not be reached.
governance.malformed: The kernel answered in a shape this app cannot read.
governance.decisions.hint: The decision-run ledger — an operator surface.
chat.sessions.heading: History
chat.sessions.rename.label: New name for {name}
chat.sessions.delete.title: Delete this conversation?
chat.sessions.delete.description: "{name}" and its whole transcript will be erased from the kernel. This cannot be undone.
chat.stream.bridge_unavailable: The on-device model is unavailable right now, so this answer came from your memory alone.
chat.stream.locale_fallback: The on-device model cannot write in {locale}, so this answer came from your memory alone.
chat.stream.bridge_exited: The on-device model closed mid-answer. Send again to retry.
chat.stream.does_not_fit: This conversation outgrew the on-device model's window — start a new chat to keep going.
chat.stream.generation_failed: The on-device model could not finish this answer. Send again to retry.
chat.stream.contract_violation: The model's answer stream could not be read.
chat.stream.cancelled: Stopped — this turn was cancelled before it finished.
chat.stream.transport: The connection to the kernel dropped mid-answer.
chat.support.supported: Grounded: every claim cites the memory it came from.
chat.support.partial: Partly grounded — the dimmed sentences have no citation behind them.
chat.support.unsupported: Not grounded: the citations on this answer do not match the memory it was given.
chat.support.abstained: The assistant declined to answer from memory.
chat.support.degraded: The memory evidence was degraded — treat this answer with care.
support.status.context: Support vertical adopted — grounded answers over the ticket corpus; escalations wait on a supervisor.
review.approve.drift: This row changed since it was shown — reload the queue and decide again.
review.approve.offline: The kernel could not be reached — nothing was approved.
review.approve.malformed: The kernel’s answer could not be verified — nothing was approved.
settings.model.heading: Retrieval model
settings.model.hint: Stays on this Mac. Recall works.
